ties.note: Double-dash water-pipe line crossing Avenue M corridor in the first street south of the 21xx house-number block (identified by counting blocks from the sheet-top street on both sheets; 21xx numbers above, 22xx below on both). LINE feature, horizontal: constrains y only; x placed at nominal seam line on both sheets.

Dashed 6-inch water pipe line (labeled 6" W. PIPE on sheet 40) in the bottom street corridor (street 24), anchored by sheet-bottom block corner just above it on both sheets. LINE feature, horizontal: y only; x at nominal seam. WARNING: implied dy here (+19) disagrees with tie-40-67-1 (-88) by ~107 px — sheets disagree or paper distortion.

Black hydrant dot labeled T.H. in 21st/Centre St corridor just east of the avenue crossing at x~2200; identified on both sheets by the label T.H. and its position NE of the avenue/21st intersection (only such dot along this seam). Measured dot center.

SE corner of the north-side block front where the 21st St block line (houses 1518-1524, nrs 2026/2028 around the corner) turns north along the avenue at x~3100. On 67 this block is drawn only as a marginal reference outline above the street; corner measured where the reference line jogs north. Schematic on 67, hence low; offset disagrees with hydrant tie by ~25-30 px.

NW corner of the X-marked outbuilding labeled 1525 1/2 (on 67), drawn on both sheets just west of the NOT OPEN(ED) unopened road, immediately south of the jog in the lot line. Identity anchored by the 1525/1527 house numbers and the unopened road.

NW corner of the small 1-story shed marked 1-x standing inside the NOT OPEN(ED) road corridor, ~100 px NE of the 1525 1/2 X-outbuilding; the only such shed along this seam. Offsets consistent with tie-67-68-1 within ~10 px.

Black hydrant dot labeled T.H. on the south side of 24th St at the NE corner of the 13xx/14xx avenue crossing; on 71b it sits between house numbers 1323 and 1401, on 67 just west of the 1402 block. Only hydrant along this seam segment. Dot center measured.

Crossing of the N-S dashed avenue pipe line with the E-W dashed 6-in water pipe in 24th St, at the avenue crossing east of house 1424 (67) / east of 1423 with 2402/2404 numbers below (71b) - the first avenue east of the T.H. hydrant crossing. Offsets agree with tie-67-71b-1 within ~20 px. Solid avenue line drawn on opposite sides of the pipe on the two sheets, hence medium.

NW corner of the dashed west wing of the building complex (labeled A. on 67, 80-ft label on 72) on the north side of 24th St at the NE corner of the N-S avenue whose house numbers read 23xx on 67 and 24xx on 72 (same avenue, opposite segments). Identity certain from position, but the drawn footprint disagrees between sheets (72 much narrower in x than in y relative to 67), so geometry is unreliable.

Center of the small detached square outbuilding just east of the same complex (east of the dashed annex), drawn on both sheets. Same anchor as tie-67-72-1. Footprint proportions disagree between the sheets - possible scale/redraw difference on 72; flagged suspicious.

Dashed water-pipe line of 24th St (top street on both sheets) where it crosses the Avenue M corridor. LINE feature, horizontal: constrains y only; x set at nominal seam line. Anchored: first E-W street from sheet top on both.

12-inch water pipe dashed line in 25th St (the 120-ft street, labeled 120 ft on 38 and 12" W.P. on 71b) crossing Avenue M. LINE feature, horizontal: y only; x at nominal seam. No shared vertical/point ink exists in this corridor-only overlap (25th crossing occupied by compass rose on 71b).

T.H. hydrant dot in Avenue N corridor just N of the 120-ft 25th St crossing, east of the Galveston & Western R.R. track; on 71b below the 1422/1424 block corner, on 72 west of the 1502 block corner. Labeled T.H. on both. Dot center measured.

Crossing of the N-S dashed 8-in water pipe in Avenue N (labeled 8" W.PIPE on 72) with the E-W dashed pipe line of the 120-ft 25th St. Offsets agree with tie-71b-72-1 within ~7 px. Note: the solid G&W R.R. track line is drawn east of the pipe on 71b but west of it on 72 - sheets disagree on rail/pipe order.

Galveston & Western R.R. solid double track line running N-S in Avenue N (the 14xx/15xx avenue - east side numbers 1501+ on 75, west side ...1424 on 71b) where it crosses the 27th St corridor. LINE feature, vertical: constrains x only; y placed mid-corridor. Note pipe/rail lateral placement disagrees sheet-to-sheet (8-in pipe 24 px W of rail on 71b, 65 px E on 75), so the rail centerline was used.

North block front line of 27th St (face of the 1402-1424 block, drawn fully on 71b; on 75 only as a schematic marginal reference line at its top edge). LINE feature, horizontal: y only. The marginal line on 75 shows an avenue gap at x1660-1735 that has no counterpart on 71b - marginal geometry is schematic; treat with caution. No true shared point object exists on this seam (75s T.H. hydrant at x2432 falls beyond 71s trimmed paper edge, where 71 shows only the T.H. label).

NE corner of the north-side block with houses 1918-1924 where its front line meets the 20xx avenue (rotated numbers 2026/2028 in avenue on 65; 2102/2104 south segment on 69). On 69 the corner is the jog in its top marginal reference line, which here matches the real avenue edges below it exactly. dy ~ -3596.

Intersection of the bayou west bank (single black line, blue wash east of it) with the north block-front line of 21st/Centre St (dashed lot line starting at the bank, numbers 2102+ eastward on 65; marginal reference line on 69 ends at the bank). dx (+88) agrees with tie-65-69-1. CAUTION: further south the two sheets draw the bayou bank with very different curvature - bank positions away from this line disagree.

Red fire-alarm box circle numbered 12 in the Avenue P corridor, opposite the dashed-outline building at house 1902 (69) / south of the 1824 block corner with 2226/2228 rotated numbers (68). Unique red circle on this seam; same number 12 on both sheets. Circle center measured (slightly cropped by sheet edge on each side).

T.H. hydrant dot in Avenue P at the cross street two blocks north of alarm box 12 (68: SE of the 1822/1824 block corner; 69: NW of the 1902/1904 block front). dx agrees with tie-68-69-1 within ~11 px but dy differs by ~50 px (the sheets also place the street pipe dashes 87 px apart in y) - vertical placement disagreement between sheets.

6-in water pipe dashed line (labeled 6" W.PIPE on 69) in the E-W street between the 21xx and 22xx blocks, crossing the Av. Q 1/2 corridor. LINE feature, horizontal: y only; x at nominal seam. Overlap is corridor-only. NOTE: 70 draws a T.H. hydrant at (248,2692) in this intersection that 69 omits at the corresponding spot (blank).

Dashed north edge line of the Not-Opened street two blocks further north, which on both sheets runs up to the bayou bank and stops. LINE feature: y only. The bank endpoint itself disagrees: 69 ends it at its x3080, 70 at its x230 (dx -2850, vs -3072 nominal) - the two sheets draw the bayou ~200 px apart in y as well; bayou geometry untrustworthy across this seam.

N-S dashed water-pipe line in the avenue whose rotated numbers read 23xx on 69 (north of 24th) and 2401-2404 on 73 (south of 24th), between the 18xx and 19xx blocks. LINE feature, vertical: x only (dx ~ +1070); y placed mid-corridor. On 69 this pipe elbows into the 24th St pipe at (140,3783); on 73 the junction area is covered by the compass rose.

6-in water pipe dashed line running E-W in 24th St (labeled 6 W.PIPE on 73). LINE feature, horizontal: y only. NOTE: 69 draws a T.H. hydrant at (222,3690) at this avenue crossing; 73 shows no dot at the corresponding location.

West edge of the 23xx/24xx avenue at 24th St, north side: on 69 the real SE corner of the 2124-block front line (rotated 2328 in the avenue); on 74 the corresponding jog in its top marginal reference line. Marginal gap on 74 (1088-1322) matches its own real avenue (1093-1288) on the west edge. dx ~ -2025.

Same avenue, south side: on 74 the real NW corner of the block with numbers 2401-2408 rotated (SW corner of avenue at 24th, west of house 2201 block); on 69 the corresponding jog in its bottom marginal reference line at y3900. dx ~ -2012, consistent with tie-69-74-1. Corridor itself is bare of pipes/hydrants on both sheets in the shared stretch.

North block-front line of the E-W street between the 18xx and 19xx blocks (numbers 1823/1824 above on 64; 1902 row on 65), projected across the Avenue P corridor. LINE feature, horizontal: y only; x at nominal seam. Avenue P corridor itself carries no shared ink (no pipes/hydrants/dashes) along this seam.

South block-front line of the same street (1821/1823 row on 64; 1901/1903 row on 65). LINE feature: y only. CAUTION: the two sheets draw this street with different widths across the avenue (250 px on 64 vs 285 px on 65), so the two line ties are mutually inconsistent by ~35 px.

NW corner of the third L-shaped cottage (labeled D. on 79) in the row of four identical cottages on the south side of 30th St, just west of the 50-ft N-S street; counted from the row west end (first cottage has a dashed east wing on both sheets). Corner offsets for cottages 2-4 agree within 12 px (dx ~ -955).

NW corner of the narrow X-marked shed on the NORTH side of 30th St at the block corner east of the vertical block line (75) - first of the pair of X-marked outbuildings. dx (-950) agrees with tie-75-79-1. CAUTION: the larger second X-building next to it is drawn ~85x80 px on 75 but ~155x130 px on 79 - footprints disagree, so only this narrow shed corner was used.

West corner of the north-side 1302-1324 block at 30th St: real dashed block outline corner on 75; on 34 the corresponding jog in its top marginal reference line. WARNING: dx implied here (+1710) conflicts with the house-number/block-edge alignment (1302 on 75 at x700 vs 1301 on 34 at x2640, real south block edge 75 x605 -> 34 x2560, dx ~ +1950) by ~245 px - 34s marginal line is schematic. Prefer the house-number alignment.

Complementary corner pair using real ink on each side of the corridor: 75s dashed NW-block corner (north side, house 1302) vs 34s real SW block-front corner under house 1301 (south side). These are NOT the same physical point (opposite sides of 30th St, ~70 ft apart in y, odd/even half-lot offset in x); usable only as an approximate dx ~ +1955, dy ~ -3460 pairing. No true shared drawn object exists on this seam (34s two T.H. hydrants lie west of 75s coverage; corridor otherwise empty).

Red fire-alarm box circle numbered 43 in the Avenue M corridor near the top of both sheets (NE of the 1221/1223 block corner on 36; NW of the 1301 block corner on 75). Same box number on both; unique on this seam. Circle center measured.

Double-dash water-pipe line in the 80-ft E-W street between the 12xx/13xx blocks (labeled 80 ft on both; 29xx rotated avenue numbers below on both sides) crossing the Avenue M corridor. LINE feature, horizontal: y only; x at nominal seam. dy (+21) agrees with alarm-box tie-36-75-1 (+19).

T.H. hydrant dot on 33rd St at the NE corner of the avenue crossing west of houses 1502 (79, north side) / 1501 (83, south side); labeled T.H. on both, just east of the N-S dashed pipe + solid avenue line pair. Dot centers measured.

Junction of the N-S dashed avenue pipe with the E-W 10-in water pipe of 33rd St at the avenue crossing east of houses 1624 (79) / 1623-Drugs corner store (83), where the pipe label changes to 8" W.PIPE on 83. dx/dy agree with tie-79-83-1 within ~22 px. NOTE: 79's second T.H. hydrant at (3288,3668) matches 83's dot at (2328,149) (found later, east of the initial crop) - dx -960, consistent.

T.H. hydrant dot on 33rd St NE of the avenue crossing west of houses 1702 (80, north side) / 1701 (83, south side); labeled T.H. on both, east of the N-S dashed avenue pipe. Same physical hydrant also appears on sheet 79 at (3288,3668).
Junction of the N-S dashed avenue pipe (16xx/17xx avenue) with the E-W water pipe of 33rd St (10" W.P. label on 80 west of it; 8" W.PIPE on 83/80 east). Offsets agree with tie-80-83-1 within ~20 px.

East edge line of the wide N-S avenue (rotated numbers 3529/3531 on 83 north of 36th; 3601-3607 on 30 south of it) - the line runs unbroken through the unopened/unpaved 36th St corridor on both sheets. LINE feature, vertical: x only. West edge line gives dx +38 vs +15 here (23 px internal disagreement). Corridor contents disagree: 83 draws a red-brown double-dashed track at its x2572 inside the avenue that 30 omits; 30 draws a solid double lane at its x2200-2215 west of the avenue that 83 omits.

North block-front line of 36th St (real line on 83; schematic top marginal reference line on 30). LINE feature, horizontal: y only. Weak - 30s marginal line is schematic; no true shared point object exists on this seam (36th is Not Opened here and the corridor is empty on both sheets).

Red fire-alarm box circle numbered 57 in the Avenue N corridor (G&W R.R. avenue), opposite the corner-store house 1501/1421-1425 blocks. Same box number on both sheets; unique on this seam. Circle center measured.
Dashed water-pipe line of 33rd St (top street on both sheets) where it crosses the Avenue N corridor. LINE feature, horizontal: y only; x at nominal seam. dy (+10) consistent with tie-32-83-1 (+4).
